question_answers.did_constraint_violation_and_policy_beha: TRAINING_CURVES.json (per-batch g_hat, lambda, cost, active share) plus PAIRED_COMPARISON.json (behaviour), never inferred from gradient norms alone
question_answers.did_the_expected_actor_amplification_hap: answerable from arithmetical_comparison_same_state_same_tape at all six runs and three batches; the observed ratio is the actor term's L2 under ACTIVE_ROWS over ALL_ROWS on identical weights and identical tape
question_answers.does_it_survive_into_the_total_and_post_: answerable from total_pre_clip_l2, policy_share_of_pre_clip, clipping_triggered and total_post_clip_l2; a post-clip equality with clipping on both sides means only the direction changed, not the magnitude
question_answers.if_there_is_no_improvement_what_is_exclu: excludable: that the reduction never reached the actor, or that the actor term was not amplified. Not excludable by this evidence: whether a different lambda, more batches, or a different observation would help -- none of those was intervened on

availability_note: this round writes the pre-update checkpoint of batches 0, 15 and 31 before ppo_update runs, so all six runs are analysable at all three indices; ROUND31 could only reach batch 0 because only the initial milestone survived

arithmetical_comparison_same_state_same_.note: the actor term's own L2 scales by N/M; the TOTAL pre-clip norm moves much less because the two critics dominate, and when global clipping fires both arms are rescaled to the same post-clip magnitude, so what the reduction changes is the DIRECTION (the actor's share of the clipped vector), not its size. Adam is nonlinear in the gradient, so this is not a step-size claim.
arithmetical_comparison_same_state_same_.tolerance_rule: relative 1e-5 on the ratio. The ratio itself is O(N/M) and reaches 51 at these points, so a fixed absolute band would really only be testing float32 digit count. Both residuals are recorded.

section: update mechanism diagnosis on the saved pre-update checkpoints (0 launches, 0 optimizer.step, pure-computation forward and autograd.grad on an in-memory copy of the saved weights)

two_kinds_of_comparison.arithmetical: same weights, same tape, both reductions in one graph: isolates the definition's direct effect
two_kinds_of_comparison.realised: each arm's own trained weights and own samples: includes policy and data distribution changes, so not every difference is the reduction's doing
